name: The Greatest Escape(room)
source:
Unfortunately, you've arrived late for your appointment at The Greatest Escape(room)!; even more unfortunately, you're just in time to see the overworked employee at the counter finally snap after dealing with one rude customer too many. 

Reborn as the Game Master, she uses her newfound power to send you to the escape rooms of her workplace–and while the settings are fantastical...

The consequences of failure are terribly real.

Solve puzzles, crack codes, do distressing amounts of math, and escape–or die!

[From [url=https://destini.itch.io/thegreatestescaperoom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
很遗憾，你迟到了，没赶上预约的“终极密室”！更不幸的是，你刚好目睹柜台那名过劳员工，在被一个又一个无礼顾客折腾后终于爆发。

她转生成了游戏主持人，获得了全新的力量，可以把你送进工作场所的各个密室。那些场景虽然充满奇幻色彩……

失败的后果却无比真实。

解开谜题、破解密码、做上令人焦虑的数学题，然后逃出生天——否则就会死！

[来源：[url=https://destini.itch.io/thegreatestescaperoom]Itch.io[/url]]
